zh.title: 波音工程師使用吹葉機找出777X推力連桿問題原因
zh.summary: 波音工程師利用吹葉機，找出777X機型2024年推力連桿挫折的根本原因。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，波音（Boeing）工程師團隊利用市售吹葉機，成功協助找出波音777X客機2024年推力連桿挫折的根本原因。這項工具協助技術團隊釐清並解決影響認證進度的組件異常問題。
據本站統計與紀錄，波音777X計劃先前已獲得美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）批准，依據第4B型別檢查授權（TIA 4B）展開認證飛行測試，預計於2027年進行首批機型交付。此外，波音777-9測試機隊的累計測試飛行時間已達到4,800小時。

en.title: Boeing Engineers Use Leaf Blower to Find 777X Setback Root Cause
en.summary: Boeing engineers used a leaf blower to identify the root cause of the 777X thrust link setback.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, Boeing engineers utilized a simple hardware store leaf blower to identify the root cause behind the 777X aircraft's 2024 thrust-link setback. The simple tool enabled technical teams to resolve the underlying component issue that had previously affected certification progress.

Historical records show that the Boeing 777X program previously obtained Federal Aviation Administration approval to commence certification flight testing under Type Inspection Authorization 4B, with initial customer deliveries expected to take place in 2027. Furthermore, the Boeing 777-9 test fleet has logged a total of 4,800 test flight hours across its evaluation campaign.
